name: workflow-autopilot
description: Use when a user directly chooses top-level autonomous goal selection and coordination. Do not activate for delegated invocation or ordinary single-task work.

name: workflow-delivery
description: Use for scoped code, tests, documentation, or configuration implementation through specification, test design, tests, implementation, and PR handoff. Not for investigation-only or standalone review.

name: workflow-failure-recovery
description: Use when a CI, test, or tool execution has actually failed and needs evidence-based recovery. Not for new work without a failure.

name: workflow-harness-evaluation
description: Use to evaluate observed agent, Skill, workflow routing, permission, or quality behavior. Not for Markdown formatting or static config checks alone.

name: workflow-harness-improvement
description: Use when recurring agent, Rulesync, Skill, workflow, or CI friction requires improvement and re-evaluation. Not for evaluation-only requests.

name: workflow-integration
description: Use only after explicit human approval and request to merge a particular PR, checking current review, CI, and permission gates. Not for PR creation or review alone.

name: workflow-investigation
description: Use when the requested result is research, comparison, design, or planning evidence. Not when the requested result is code implementation.

name: workflow-resumption
description: Use when restarting interrupted or stale session/PR work by reconciling live Git, CI, and Inbox state. Not for a short task with already verified state.

name: workflow-review
description: Use for a standalone evidence-backed review of a PR, diff, code, docs, or harness. Not a replacement for routine implementation self-review.
